title: Fabulous Views
text: Enjoyable walk with fabulous scenery.  Trainers were fine.  The best part is the final mile 😀. Our driver was fun, spoke great English and collected us at the end of the trail.
author: John_M

title: Well worth doing
text:
Miguel was a friendly driver and ensured we made the tour on time, and provided clear instructions on where to meet him at the end once we were ready.
The tour of the Caminto del Ray was a liesurely walking pace, but at times felt rushed due to the narrow pathway and need to maintain contact with the guide so that headphone signal remained connected. The experience and hike was great, but my preference in future would be an unguided walk at own pace.
author: Tim_G

title: Great experience!
text: Staying in Granada, we had a hefty drive to get to the Caminito del Rey but Jose was a fantastic driver. Clean car and pleasant conversation (but allowed us a siesta too). He also got us into an earlier tour since we arrived earlier than expected. Our guide on the walk was good, imparting information and with a touch of humor. He was sensitive to those who were afraid of heights. Hubby has a little fear but even he didn’t think this walk was scary.
author: Lee_and_Paul

title: Well worth it
text:
We took the Caminito del Rey day trip from Granada with Discovering Spain, and overall, it was a great experience. Communication with the tour agency was smooth, and we had no trouble locating the meeting point using Google Maps. Our group was small—just four people (2+2)—so we traveled comfortably in a sedan. Our driver, Manuel, was friendly and spoke English well. During the 1 hour and 45-minute ride, he provided an informative overview of Granada and the surrounding areas.

Upon arriving at the Caminito del Rey parking lot, we had a 20-minute walk to the actual entrance of the trail. Manuel
author: Gulcan_O

title: A bucket list top contender.
text: Excellent views and a marvellous of engineering. If a hot day ensure you have plenty of water and snacks. There are some steep steps up and down. So if you have any injuries or difficulties you may need to reconsider. This also goes for if you have a fear of heights. Overall an excellent day trip. We had and excellent driver which made the 2hr trip each way more enjoyable. He had an excellent knowledge of Spain and Granada.
author: Robert_H

title: Highly recommend
text: Gorgeous views!!! Jose, our driver was friendly and provided information along the drive.  Our guide for the actual tour of Caminito del Rey provided entertaining and educational information.
author: Discover531743

title: Highly recommend!
text: We loved this experience!! Our driver, Jose, picked us up near our hotel in Granada and drove us 2 hours to El caminito del Rey. He was very knowledgeable and shared many great facts with us along the drive. He made sure we arrived safely to the entrance, and handed us off to Gregorio, (tour guide in El caminito, who was also fantastic!). The views were absolutely amazing. Jose was waiting for us at the end of the tour - he had vip parking (so we didn't have to do extra walking in the heat!). Cristina C, who works at the office, was so nice and so easy to work with. author: Linda A

title: Highly recommend it - Especially our guide Gonzalo!!
text: We had a wonderful day trip from Granada to Caminito del Rey, made even more enjoyable and memorable thanks to our guide, Gonzalo. He was punctual, knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and engaging throughout the entire experience. Gonzalo spoke excellent English and clearly explained what to expect during the trip, making us feel well-prepared and comfortable. He was incredibly patient and thoughtful, stopping along the way to show us beautiful viewpoints and recommending a great restaurant. author: TAMMY_F

title: A terrific experience not to be missed
text:
The tour consisted of a bus trip from Granada to Carminito del Rey where the real guided tour started. We were assigned guides and we had a great guide who took the time and paced the walk perfectly. She was enthusiastic and spent her time talking about how the dam project evolved and also talked about the flora and fauna. We were passed by numerous groups so our walk was easy and leisurely. 
Although apprehensive about heights, once started it was not a problem
A wonderful experience not to be missed .
author: Timothy_Y
